note: Every make command the documentation advertises, and where its failures surface. tools/coverage_map.py checks this rather than trusting it: a stage that claims to run a target must actually run it, an aggregate that claims to cover one must list it, a workflow that claims to run one must contain it, and a newly advertised command with no entry here fails the check.

.:bug-report.prerequisite: an EXAMPLE= to export from or a RECORD= to replay
.:bug-report.surfaces: the doc-examples stage, which runs bug-report-check: the same export and replay over a finished session, a failed one, and a payload that is stale or missing

.:config-check.prerequisite: a CONFIG= profile path to check
.:config-check.surfaces: the system-profiles stage, which runs the same resolver over every profile in configs/

.:doctor.note: reports which host tools are present

.:experiment-export.prerequisite: a CANDIDATE= with a recorded result
.:experiment-export.surfaces: the experiment-adapters stage, whose experiment-report-check exports a bundle and rebuilds it from that description alone

.:experiment-replay.prerequisite: a RECORD= naming an executed record to reproduce
.:experiment-replay.surfaces: the experiment-adapters stage, whose adapter-check replays a recorded candidate through the same code path and requires that a changed artifact hash is rejected

.:experiment-report.surfaces: the experiment-adapters stage, whose experiment-report-check renders the same plans and requires that domains stay apart, a missing measurement satisfies no bound, and excluded candidates are named

.:experiment-reproduce.surfaces: the experiment-adapters stage, whose experiment-report-check reproduces a bundle and refuses one whose inputs or evidence level changed

.:fpga.prerequisite: the ECP5/Gowin open toolchain (yosys, nextpnr, packer)
.:fpga.surfaces: the synthesis and P&R evidence recorded under research/ and the board guides

.:fpga-loader.prerequisite: the open FPGA toolchain, and a board to load onto
.:fpga-loader.surfaces: the board bring-up procedure in docs/tangprimer25k-bringup.md

.:fpga-loader-primer.prerequisite: the open Gowin toolchain and a Tang Primer 25K

.:fuzz-coverage.prerequisite: a long unbounded fuzzing run and coverage instrumentation

.:load.prerequisite: a connected board and its programmer

.:nightly-integrated.note: runs the nightly suite; every stage in it is an entry here

.:primer-runtime-preflight.surfaces: the Primer runtime evidence in docs/design-checklist.md

.:sim.note: runs one profile interactively for a person to watch

.:verify-smoke.note: runs the smoke suite; every stage in it is an entry here

.:web-compare.prerequisite: emscripten (em++) and a built WebAssembly bundle
.:web-compare.surfaces: the browser/native comparison records under research/

.:web-compare-check.prerequisite: emscripten (em++) and a built WebAssembly bundle
.:web-compare-check.surfaces: the browser/native comparison records under research/

.:web-page-check.prerequisite: emscripten (em++) and a built WebAssembly bundle
.:web-page-check.surfaces: the browser evidence recorded in docs/design-checklist.md

formal:check-all.prerequisite: the riscv-formal stack and hours of solver time; the bounded subsets are what run automatically

rtl/fpga:check-tools.prerequisite: the open FPGA toolchain, whose versions it reports
rtl/fpga:check-tools.surfaces: the toolchain versions recorded in every FPGA evidence file

rtl/fpga:config.prerequisite: nothing; it prints the resolved board profile
rtl/fpga:config.surfaces: the system-profiles stage, which resolves every profile

rtl/fpga:flash.prerequisite: a connected board; deliberately unused, see the Primer gate in docs/design-checklist.md

rtl/fpga:pr-delta.prerequisite: the open ECP5 toolchain and a locked shell build
rtl/fpga:pr-delta.surfaces: the pr-gate-check contract in the research-contracts stage

rtl/fpga:program.prerequisite: a connected board and its programmer

rtl/fpga:synth.surfaces: the synthesis baselines checked by tools/synth_baseline.py

rtl/fpga:toolchain-report.surfaces: the toolchain versions recorded in every FPGA evidence file

sim/axsim:axsim.note: builds the instruction-set simulator that other checks run

sim/fuzz:explore.prerequisite: an unbounded run; the bounded form is make fuzz-loader
sim/fuzz:explore.surfaces: .github/workflows/analysis.yml, which runs the bounded form nightly

sw/baremetal:images.note: builds the bare-metal payloads the checks below load

sw/kernel:images.note: builds the kernel images the checks below load
